CHANGELOG updated in CarePyre: feat(community-tools): real Resume/CV builder + verifier panel in console.html -- Basics fields, dynamic Work/Education entry lists, Save+Verify with itemized per-rule report. Fixed a real HTML-attribute-injection risk found before shipping (esc() into value="..." -- switched to safe DOM property assignment). Apple #18729. (sess-20260905-0720-ec33e7c5)
